Vegetable prices surge in Haryana, impacting household budgets

Vegetable prices have significantly increased in Haryana, affecting household budgets. Peas and ginger are reportedly selling for over ₹200 per kilogram, while the prices of tomatoes and onions have also doubled. Shopkeepers have noted that the surge in prices is impacting sales. The rising cost of essential vegetables is straining household kitchens.
